name: Off-Hand Front V-Dribble
setup: Athletic stance, knees bent, ball in one hand at the side, eyes up.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your less-used hand: slow and clean beats fast and messy.
Push the ball side to side in a V in front, hard on the floor at the bottom.
Eyes up on a target on the wall, not on the ball.

faults.fault: Slapping the ball with a flat palm
faults.fix: Push the ball with the finger pads and ride it on the way up.
Hold the free arm up as a bar between the ball and the cone.

name: Off-Hand Coast-to-Coast Euro Step Layup
setup: Start on the baseline with the ball.

faults.fix: Push the ball further ahead and run onto it.
